blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines and Japan began on Sunday a six-day joint humanitarian assistance and disaster relief exercise in key military bases and civilian airports in Luzon and the Visayas. The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) and Japan Self-Defense Forces (JSDF) will conduct the “Doshin-Bayanihan 6-26” exercise from Oct. 4 to 9. According to a document released by the Japan Air Self-Defense Force (ASDF), the training will be conducted at Mactan-Benito Ebuen Air Base in Cebu, Daniel Z.
